channel.title: Paksh: Economy
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.description: Top trade envoys from China and the European Union concluded two days of talks aimed at de-escalating rising tensions over significant economic imbalances. During these discussions, France and Germany reportedly proposed a 'trade bazooka'… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Manchester City's Financial Status Questioned Amidst Scandal
item.description: Manchester City's financial stability is being questioned, with reports suggesting the club may be 'too big to fail'. The club has also been described as a catalyst for Manchester's rebirth, despite being scandal-tainted. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Wes Maas Sells Shopping Mall Amid Firmus Float Fallout
item.description: Wes Maas has sold a $50 million shopping mall, with his company reportedly paying the price for a significant investment in Firmus. The sale comes as a consequence of the fallout from the Firmus float. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: India and Singapore are planning a 3,000-kilometer cross-border power transmission link that would traverse through ASEAN nations. The proposed corridor aims to connect India to Singapore via Myanmar, Thailand, and Malaysia. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.description: France is reportedly facing a potential debt crisis, with concerns escalating due to record debt levels and ongoing high school protests. Economic indicators suggest France's debt is riskier than that of 38% of the nation's company bonds… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.
